findings.text: Threats are listed by component, with no risk rating and no ordering by risk. The rubric's level 5 for clarity asks for ordering by risk.

rubric_items.reason: All eight design components, CO-1 to CO-8, appear with at least one threat each. The components that show personal data (CO-1, CO-6, CO-7) each have an information disclosure or tampering threat.
Most threats fit their component, for example the SQL branch for NOT_CANCELLED, the widened status allowed list and the weakened Today href test. T-12 is fairly generic.

Every mitigation cites a control or names a new one for implement. T-4's mitigation (20 rows per page) does not address how often requests are sent, and T-13 reasons from the data instead of the log code that removes the query string.
Assumed, Unknown and Open questions are all None, and the cited controls do check out. The missing limit on requests per keystroke in Picker is not stated as a gap.
Readable and consistent between the front matter and the body. Threats are listed by component, not by risk, and carry no risk rating.
